label: Origin-determined access and origin-compatible deletion give worldwise deletion
description: Conditional entailment: if access is exactly shared-origin closeness, any world lacking x whose shared individuals keep near origins is accessible, so origin-compatible deletion yields worldwise deletion. Only the OPEN if-half of origin-determined access is used; the deleted individual's own origin imposes no condition, because it is not shared. With deletionOriginCompatible, under origin-determined access worldwise deletion is equivalent to origin-compatible deletion, a world-inventory principle the encoded origin commitments do not settle (OriginDeletion.Control.Certificate: faithful and restored violate deletion, withEmpty satisfies it, all with the four origin commitments).
